# The Intent Skill stands alone (External use): Intent

> PLAN (`intent/C9`). It ships no code, Node or test, and authorizes no synchronization, promotion, version change or npm publication. It answers the CTO's External-use finding (portfolio view of 3 Nov 2026, §6, gaps X3 to X5) for Intent's own package. It needs nothing from Hosting or main and is independent of `intent/C5` and `intent/C6`.

External use means an agent that has only the text of a Skill, in a repository with no KAAL Engine, no installation and no registration. The portfolio view rates Intent's External value High (IDEA and I WON are method), but that rating is a reading of the text, not a test.

- **intent/I10.** An agent with only the Intent Skill's text can capture an Intent correctly: what is wanted and why, complete enough to be understood alone. It needs no Engine, no command and no other file to do so, and the Skill says what it will and will not write.
- **intent/I11.** One authoritative text serves all three concerns (Engineering, Embedded, External). Intent adds no parallel External copy of its meaning. The Node `Intent` stays the deeper reference, never a prerequisite.

## What the text says today

Read from `origin/kaal/intent` (nothing was run):

| Question | Finding |
| --- | --- |
| Does the Skill need the Engine? | Yes, in its first paragraph. `SKILL.md` says what an Intent is "is stated by the Node `Intent` in a KAAL Engine: read it there, starting from the Engine's `AGENTS.md`". An outside agent has no Engine to read. The meaning is in `payload/Intent.md`, not in the Skill |
| Does it need a command? | Only in the reference. `references/intent.md` mentions `kaal identify` to get a Node id, which is an Embedded act. Capturing the Intent's text needs no command |
| Does it need another file? | The Skill points at `references/intent.md` for the form, which ships beside it. The Definition id pinned in the form means nothing to an outside reader and is harmless to them |
| What authority does it imply? | The Skill says capturing authorizes nothing and that an Intent meant to drive product work returns to the Product Owner. It says nothing about where, or whether, the agent writes the captured text |
